title: Hontiveros calls for hydration facilities amid Super El Niño

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Risa Hontiveros on Tuesday urged local government units (LGUs) and the private sector to set up hydration stations and cooling centers in public spaces amid Super El Niño. Hontiveros, head of the Senate Committee on Health and Demography, said reporting the day’s heat index alone was not enough and that people should not have to spend more to prevent dehydration and heat stroke.
